A memopayload runner was also found.

Checking whether the memopayload runner relates to external attachments. Reading attachment_service_storage.go to understand how S3 handles externally stored content.

The memopayload runner rebuilds memo payloads, not attachment links.

The s3presign runner refreshes S3 attachment URLs before their five-day expiration. It re-signs links within four days of expiry every twelve hours. Server.Start calls startBackgroundRunners at line 129. That function creates the runner at lines 161–171.

I will cite `server/server.go:129` as the direct startup wiring point. I am also checking `cmd/memos/main.go` for alternative startup paths.

The S3 presign runner is the component responsible for keeping external attachment links fresh.

It runs every 12 hours. An immediate `RunOnce` happens on startup. `Server.Start()` calls `startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go:129`. The runner is created at lines 161–171.

The runner schedule is defined in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`.

Only S3 attachments require presigned URL refresh. EXTERNAL storage types expose ExternalLink without needing periodic renewal.
